tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv '
SELECT
  DATE(event_time) AS d,
  ROUND(AVG(f1),3) f1, ROUND(AVG(f2),3) f2, ROUND(AVG(f3),3) f3,
  ROUND(AVG(f4),3) f4, ROUND(AVG(f5),3) f5, ROUND(AVG(f6),3) f6
FROM `'"${GCP_BQ_DATASET}"'.features`
GROUP BY d ORDER BY d' 2>&1
